verdict.rationale: Fivetran explicitly supports 700+ connectors syncing to major warehouses/lakes (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres) and object storage/data lakes with open table formats, with a documented destinations catalog, and community evidence corroborates the Fivetran+Snowflake+dbt stack working reliably in practice without pipeline rewrites. Missing for 10: explicit named confirmation of Databricks and Postgres as destinations in the excerpted docs (only generic 'destinations' catalog cited) and independent benchmarking of cross-destination pipeline portability.
